subject: Final pass: executive summary + redline runbook for board update
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Final pass: executive summary + redline runbook for board update

Team — attaching the annotated deck (v3) and a short runbook for the board meeting next week. High-level asks: 1) final signoff on the executive summary slide (p4), 2) confirm the OKR callouts & NPS number on p7, 3) accept the proposed backup plan slide for model fallbacks (p12).

Quick context: investors requested a tighter one-page exec summary and a 2-minute talking track focused on economics (latency/cost savings) and reliability improvements since last quarter. I added inline redlines and comments in OKR-highlights-annotated.md — please treat those as requests rather than final language.

Deadlines: please return edits or explicit approvals by EOD Wednesday (Apr 21, 5pm PT). I will consolidate and run a dry-run on Thursday morning. If you cannot meet that timeline, flag me with the slides you own.

Attachments: 2027_Q2_board_deck_v3.pdf, OKR-highlights-annotated.md

Jonas Weber
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final pass: executive summary + redline runbook for board update

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 8:13 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the annotated deck (v3) and a short runbook for the board meeting next week. High-level asks: 1) final signoff on the executive summary slide (p4), 2) confirm the OKR callouts & NPS number on p7, 3) accept the proposed backup plan slide for model fallbacks (p12).
> 
> Deadlines: please return edits or explicit approvals by EOD Wednesday (Apr 21, 5pm PT).

Thanks Jonas — read through and left a few concrete redlines:
- Exec summary: tighten the lead metric sentence to reference "requests/sec" uplift (I suggested phrasing in the annotation).
- OKR slide (p7): we should replace the topline ARR delta with the ARR ARR-growth-by-segment number from finance — see attached finance_Q2_numbers.csv.
- Customer story: move the Aurora case study to the appendix and surface the retail benchmark on p9.

I approve the fallback slide conceptually but please remove the internal runbook excerpt from the public deck (move to appendix). I can make these edits and push v3.1 unless someone objects.

Marissa Cole
Head of Marketing
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: finance_Q2_numbers.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final pass: executive summary + redline runbook for board update

Thanks — quick notes from my side:
- Economics slide (p6): agree with Marissa, finance numbers need to match the csv. Laura, can you confirm the token-cost delta and provide an annotated number for the slide (including assumptions for batching improvements)?
- Exec summary length: prefer 3 bullets that map to product/GT M/ops. Jonas, I drafted alternative bullets in a comment — feel free to adopt.
- Slide p12 (fallbacks): please add a single-line note about SLA commitments and the canary rollback threshold. That helps with Q&A.

I can take the SLA line and the rollback threshold wording. No objections to Marissa moving Aurora to the appendix.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Ryan Holt <ryan@olivecap.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marisol Perez <marisol@scaleventures.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick questions re: upcoming board update

Jonas — thanks for sharing the deck. A couple of quick asks from our side:
1) Can you surface the churn reduction attribution slide earlier in the deck? We want to see the customer impact up front.
2) Is there a one-page handout / cover memo for investors summarizing the key asks and asks of the board? If not, could you produce a one-pager?

Also, would it be possible to join the dry-run on Thursday (I can be briefed for 10 minutes)? Either me or Marisol would like to sit in.

Ryan Holt
Partner, Olive Capital
ryan@olivecap.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Holt <ryan@olivecap.com>, Marisol Perez <marisol@scaleventures.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 00:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final pass: executive summary + redline runbook for board update

Thanks all — short status and next steps: 1) Marissa will push v3.1 with the copy/placement edits and move Aurora to the appendix (ETA Wed 12pm PT). 2) Laura — please confirm finance numbers (token cost delta & ARR split) by Wed 3pm PT; use finance_Q2_numbers.csv as source. 3) Vivek will add the SLA + rollback threshold bullet (ETA Wed 1pm PT). 4) I will produce the one-page investor memo (cover memo + 3 bullets) and share by Wed 4pm PT.

Dry-run plan: Thu Apr 22 9:00am PT — 30min. Ryan/Marisol, happy to have you join for the first 10min walkthrough; I will share the calendar invite once Marissa uploads v3.1.

Attachments to follow: 2027_Q2_board_deck_v3.1.pdf (when ready).

If anyone has gating concerns about the executive summary language, flag now — otherwise assume approvals and I will lock slides by Thu morning.

Jonas Weber
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
